stories.summary: Anthropic has committed $3.4 billion to secure 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR Solutions, taking over existing Caterpillar orders as lengthy equipment lead times push AI companies to build their own power infrastructure

stories.title: Memory shortage spurs smartphone makers to melt used memory off old devices, then re-solder it onto new products
stories.summary: Reballed memory currently accounts for a small share of smartphone components, but adoption could nearly double by 2027 as manufacturers look for alternatives to increasingly expensive DRAM.

stories.title: Lawyer builds private AI server with eight used Nvidia V100 GPUs
stories.summary: A lawyer runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on eight used 2018-era Nvidia V100 GPUs at up to 215 tokens/s, keeping case files in the office.

stories.title: China builds massive 800-megawatt AI data center campus to rival US Stargate project
stories.summary: Envision has delivered the first 120MW of its Galaxy AI datacenter in less than a year, combining wind farms, battery storage and an unconventional cooling system to cut costs and keep power-hungry servers running
